validation.scope: Final source and rendered documentation previews
validation.finishReview: Scoped ship after all four flagged fixes were resolved.
validation.limitation: Rendered previews verify control content and artwork composition. The actual desktop menu, runtime placement, system light/dark appearance, assistive-technology behavior and new hardware behavior were not visually tested.

equalizer.attribution: Three published recommendations, two Bose Bar starting points and Flat; details in docs/eq-presets.md.
equalizer.presentation: Native submenu with Bass / Mid / Treble values, actual-value checkmarks, description/source tooltips and a guide link.
equalizer.selection: Named matching preset or Custom; presets outside reported band ranges are disabled.
equalizer.undo: One-level Undo last preset, available when a previous EQ snapshot exists.
equalizer.verification: Serial writes with complete readback and attempted restore on failure; no automatic preset application.

documentationArtwork.label: Rendered preview
documentationArtwork.data: Synthetic demo data; no Bluetooth access or private device identifiers.
documentationArtwork.runtime: Documentation presentation only; the application retains native AppKit colors and controls.
